title: Exploring the underlying structure of mental disorders: cross-diagnostic differences and similarities from a network perspective using both a top-down and a bottom-up approach
limitations: - Only three diagnostic groups included; - Five specific mental states used; - Heterogeneous samples; - No formal statistical comparison of networks; - PCA interpretation is subjective
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the main text, but supplementary materials may contain them. The network estimation used multilevel regression models, not specific network estimation packages like 'qgraph' for estimation, though visualization used 'qgraph'.
